# orders configuration

Generated by docuconf from the configuration contract of `orders` `1.0.0`, exported by `docuconf-spring` `0.1.0-SNAPSHOT` (java). Do not edit this file: change the app's declaration, export the contract again, then run `docuconf docs`.

`orders` reads 6 environment variables and no files. 1 is required, and 1 is secret.

## Contents

**[Environment variables](#environment-variables)**

- [`ORDERS_ALLOWEDORIGINS`](#orders_allowedorigins): Origins allowed to call the API from a browser
- [`ORDERS_DATABASEURL`](#orders_databaseurl): Postgres connection URL for the orders database (required, secret)
- [`ORDERS_LOGLEVEL`](#orders_loglevel): Minimum level of the log lines the service writes
- [`ORDERS_PORT`](#orders_port): HTTP listen port
- [`ORDERS_REQUESTTIMEOUT`](#orders_requesttimeout): Time allowed to answer one request
- [`ORDERS_WORKERCOUNT`](#orders_workercount): Background workers that process new orders

| Property | Value |

| Type | `int` (integer) |
| Required | no |

| Constraints | between 1 and 64 |

Each worker holds one connection from the pool of `databaseUrl`, so keep this below the database's connection limit.

- Raise it when the order queue backs up.
- Lower it when the database is the bottleneck.

## Sources

Where the platform may get each input from, as named in the tables above. A secret comes only from a secret store or an injector.

- `literal`: a literal value in the platform's values file
- `injected`: supplied when the container starts by an injector (`injected`), such as Bank-Vaults, `op run` or the Vault Agent injector; checked at boot
- `secretKeyRef`: a key of a Kubernetes Secret (`secretKeyRef`)
- `configMapKeyRef`: a key of a ConfigMap (`configMapKeyRef`), checked at boot
- `resourceFieldRef`: a container resource limit or request (`resourceFieldRef`), such as `limits.memory`

## Boot errors

At boot the SDK checks every input and reports all problems together, one line each, with one of these codes. Secret values never appear in the messages.

| Code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `missing_required` | A required input is not set, and has no default. | Set it through one of its allowed sources. |
| `invalid_type` | The value does not parse as the input's type in its wire format, or a secret still holds an unresolved injector reference (`vault:`, `op://`, `ref+`). | Write the value in the input's wire format. For an injected secret, make sure the injector runs. |
| `out_of_range` | A number, duration, length or list item is outside the input's bounds. | Use a value within the input's constraints. |
| `not_in_enum` | The value is not one of the allowed values. | Use one of the listed values, spelled exactly as listed. |
| `invalid_scheme` | The URL's scheme is not one of the allowed schemes. | Use a URL with an allowed scheme. |
| `too_few_items` | The list has fewer items than its minimum. | Add items. |
